_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. aboardhr.com is a Framer site: its stylesheets are inline <style> blocks that declare hashed --token-<uuid> custom properties (raw/css-vars.json), and components carry data-framer-name attributes. A leaf either names a variable ("var") whose value is the browser-resolved one in css-vars.json, or carries a measured "value" with the measurement it came from in "source" (a component/state of raw/measurements.md). Several brand fills are painted in Display P3; the token records the sRGB conversion and names the P3 original in the description. One theme: the site paints a single light scheme.
